subject: DI03005021

body.en:
Definition and principle

A fluid continuously deforms under an applied shear stress. A liquid is approximately volume-preserving under ordinary pressure changes; gas volume depends strongly on pressure/temperature. An ideal fluid is an inviscid model, not a substance with zero density. A real fluid has viscosity and dissipates mechanical energy. Fluid statics studies fluids at rest; fluid dynamics studies motion and its forces.

Important points

A stationary ordinary fluid supports normal pressure but no sustained shear stress. Density is mass per volume; specific weight is weight per volume. Viscosity and compressibility are independent classifications: a liquid can be viscous yet nearly incompressible. State the modelling assumptions before using an ideal-fluid equation.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Applied shear stress હેઠળ સતત deform થતો પદાર્થ Fluid છે.સામાન્ય pressure changes માં liquid નું volume આશરે સ્થિર રહે છે; gas નું volume pressure/temperature થી ઘણું બદલાય છે.Ideal Fluid inviscid model છે, zero-density substance નહીં.Real Fluid માં viscosity તથા mechanical-energy dissipation હોય છે.Statics માં rest પરના અને Dynamics માં motion તથા forces હેઠળના fluids નો અભ્યાસ થાય છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Rest પરનો સામાન્ય fluid normal pressure સહન કરે છે, પણ sustained shear stress નહીં.Density એકમ volume દીઠ mass અને specific weight એકમ volume દીઠ weight છે.Viscosity તથા compressibility જુદા classifications છે; liquid viscous હોવા છતાં nearly incompressible હોઈ શકે છે.Ideal-fluid equation પહેલાં assumptions સ્પષ્ટ કરો.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition and principle

Pressure is normal force per unit area. Static pressure is the local thermodynamic pressure measured by a correctly oriented wall tap. Dynamic pressure is the kinetic-energy-per-volume term, not an extra isotropic pressure acting at every wall. Vacuum indicates pressure below the local atmospheric pressure.

Important points

Gauge pressure uses local atmosphere as zero; absolute pressure uses perfect vacuum as zero. Positive vacuum magnitude is atmospheric minus absolute pressure. Use absolute pressure for vapour-pressure/cavitation or gas calculations. Stagnation pressure equals static plus dynamic pressure only under the appropriate incompressible, negligible-loss stopping model. Pressure units are Pa=N m⁻².

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

એકમ area દીઠ normal force એટલે Pressure.યોગ્ય wall tap થી મળતું local thermodynamic pressure એ Static Pressure છે.Dynamic Pressure kinetic energy per volume નો term છે; તે દરેક wall પર લાગતું વધારાનું isotropic pressure નથી.Local atmospheric pressure કરતાં ઓછું pressure એટલે Vacuum.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Gauge Pressure નું zero local atmosphere અને Absolute Pressure નું zero perfect vacuum છે.Positive vacuum magnitude એટલે atmospheric minus absolute pressure. Vapour-pressure/cavitation તથા gas calculations માં absolute pressure લો.યોગ્ય incompressible, negligible-loss stopping model હેઠળ જ stagnation pressure static તથા dynamic pressure ના sum જેટલું થાય છે.Pressure નો SI એકમ Pa=N m⁻² છે.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition and principle

A compressible-flow model allows appreciable density changes. An incompressible model treats density as constant for the process under study. These are modelling descriptions, not simply synonyms for gas and liquid.

Important points

Liquids are often approximated as incompressible; gases can also be approximately incompressible when pressure/density changes are sufficiently small. Compressibility matters in compressors, high-speed gases and pressure transients. Do not apply constant-density Bernoulli or a liquid flowmeter formula uncritically to a strongly compressible gas.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Density માં નોંધપાત્ર ફેરફાર લેતું model Compressible છે.Process દરમિયાન density constant માનતું model Incompressible છે.આ modelling descriptions છે; ફક્ત gas તથા liquid ના synonyms નથી.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Liquids ને ઘણીવાર incompressible માનવામાં આવે છે; ઓછા pressure/density changes ધરાવતો gas પણ આશરે incompressible માન્ય થઈ શકે છે.Compressors, high-speed gases તથા pressure transients માં compressibility મહત્વની છે.Strongly compressible gas માટે constant-density Bernoulli અથવા liquid meter formula બિનશરતી ન વાપરો.

અંતિમ સમીકરણ

body.en:
Definition

A simple U-tube manometer compares pressure through hydrostatic liquid columns.

Construction

A transparent U-shaped tube contains a suitable manometric liquid. One limb connects to the pressure tap and the other is open to atmosphere for a simple gauge instrument. A graduated scale shows interface/free-surface elevations. The manometric fluid must be compatible, immiscible where required, and suitable for the pressure range; mercury is not a default classroom reagent.

Working and applications

Applied pressure displaces the columns until hydrostatic equilibrium is established. Trace pressure downward by adding density×g×height and upward by subtracting it. For a gas over a much denser liquid, the gas-column correction is often negligible; for liquid-filled connections it may not be. The difference of vertical levels, not distance along the tube, is required. A positive tap pressure and a vacuum give opposite displacement directions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Hydrostatic liquid columns વડે pressure compare કરતું instrument Simple U-tube Manometer છે.

રચના (Construction)

Transparent U-shaped tube માં યોગ્ય manometric liquid હોય છે.Simple gauge instrument માં એક limb pressure tap સાથે અને બીજું atmosphere સાથે જોડાય છે.Graduated scale પરથી interface/free-surface elevations વાંચાય છે.Liquid compatible, જરૂર મુજબ immiscible અને pressure range માટે યોગ્ય હોવું જોઈએ.Mercury ને default classroom reagent ન માનવું.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Applied pressure થી columns ખસે છે અને hydrostatic equilibrium બને છે.Pressure trace કરતાં નીચે જતાં density×g×height ઉમેરો અને ઉપર જતાં ઘટાડો.Dense manometric liquid ઉપર gas હોય તો gas-column correction ઘણીવાર negligible હોય છે; liquid-filled connection માં નહીં.Vertical level difference લેવો, tube ની length નહીં.Positive pressure તથા vacuum માં displacement ની directions વિરુદ્ધ હોય છે.

body.en:
Definition

An inclined manometer improves sensitivity to small pressure differences.

Construction

A large-area well is connected to a narrow transparent tube fixed at angle θ to the horizontal. A scale measures the displacement along the inclined limb. The well carries one pressure and the tube end the other, commonly atmosphere. The sketch assumes the well is sufficiently large for its level change to be negligible.

Working and applications

A small pressure difference produces a relatively long scale movement because only its vertical component supplies hydrostatic head. This increases reading sensitivity for low gas-pressure differences. Use the actual angle and meniscus reference. If well depression is not negligible, include it in total vertical head rather than blindly using the sine relation alone. It is less compact and needs careful levelling.

Governing relation
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

નાના pressure differences માટે વધુ sensitivity આપતું instrument Inclined Manometer છે.

રચના (Construction)

મોટા area વાળો well horizontal સાથે θ angle પરની narrow transparent tube સાથે જોડાય છે.Scale inclined limb ની displacement માપે છે.Well પર એક pressure તથા tube end પર બીજું, ઘણીવાર atmosphere, હોય છે.Sketch માં well area મોટું હોવાથી તેનો level change negligible માનેલો છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

ઓછા pressure difference થી લાંબું scale movement મળે છે, કારણ કે તેનો vertical component જ hydrostatic head આપે છે.તેથી નાના gas-pressure differences માટે sensitivity વધે છે.Actual angle તથા meniscus reference લો.Well depression negligible ન હોય તો total vertical head માં તેને ઉમેરો; ફક્ત sine relation ન લો.Instrument ને careful levelling તથા વધુ જગ્યા જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

A DP cell senses the difference between two applied pressures.

Construction

It contains high- and low-pressure chambers separated by a sensing diaphragm or equivalent elastic element. Impulse lines transmit process pressures to these chambers. A mechanical linkage or electrical transducer senses deflection; an electronic transmitter may use capacitance, piezoresistance or another calibrated principle.

Working and applications

The pressure difference produces a net force and diaphragm movement, which is converted to an indication/signal. It measures differential pressure directly; flow, level or filter resistance is inferred only with the appropriate model. Density, impulse-leg elevation, wet/dry legs and zero/span calibration affect the result. Isolate/equalise using the approved manifold sequence; do not expose a low-range cell to unbalanced process pressure.

Governing relation
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

બે applied pressures નો તફાવત sense કરતું instrument DP Cell છે.

રચના (Construction)

તેમાં high તથા low pressure chambers વચ્ચે sensing diaphragm અથવા equivalent elastic element હોય છે.Impulse lines process pressures પહોંચાડે છે.Mechanical linkage અથવા electrical transducer deflection sense કરે છે.Electronic transmitter માં capacitance, piezoresistance અથવા અન્ય calibrated principle હોઈ શકે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Pressure difference થી net force તથા diaphragm movement થાય છે અને indication/signal મળે છે.Instrument સીધું differential pressure માપે છે; flow, level અથવા filter resistance માટે યોગ્ય model જરૂરી છે.Density, impulse-leg elevations, wet/dry legs તથા zero/span calibration result ને અસર કરે છે.Approved manifold sequence મુજબ isolate/equalise કરો.Low-range cell પર unbalanced process pressure ન આપો.

મૂળ સંબંધ

body.en:
Definition

A continuous gravity decanter separates compatible immiscible liquids by density difference.

Construction

A settling vessel provides a quiet separation zone for two substantially immiscible liquids of different density. It has a feed inlet/baffle, light-liquid overflow, heavy-liquid withdrawal and an arrangement to control the interface/outlet heads. A vent, inspection provisions and suitable level control complete the system; the diagram shows separate upper/lower liquid layers.

Working and applications

The feed slows inside the vessel. Droplets of the heavier phase settle and lighter droplets rise/coalesce. The light phase leaves from the upper outlet and the heavy phase through its controlled lower route, allowing continuous separation. Interface position depends on densities, outlet elevations and backpressure, not density alone. Adequate residence time is essential; stable emulsions or mutually soluble components are not separated simply by increasing vessel height.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Density difference વડે immiscible liquids નું continuous separation કરતું vessel Gravity Decanter છે.

રચના (Construction)

અલગ density ધરાવતા substantially immiscible liquids માટે vessel માં quiet settling zone હોય છે.Feed inlet/baffle, light-liquid overflow, heavy-liquid outlet તથા interface/outlet heads control કરવાની arrangement હોય છે.Vent, inspection તથા suitable level control જરૂરી છે.Diagram માં upper તથા lower liquid layers અલગ દર્શાવ્યાં છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ અને ઉપયોગો

Vessel માં feed ધીમો પડે છે.Heavy droplets settle થાય છે અને light droplets ઉપર જઈ coalesce થાય છે.Light phase upper outlet તથા heavy phase controlled lower route થી સતત નીકળે છે.Interface position densities ઉપરાંત outlet elevations તથા backpressure પર આધારિત છે.Adequate residence time જરૂરી છે.Stable emulsions અથવા mutually soluble components ને ફક્ત vessel ઊંચું કરવાથી અલગ કરી શકાતાં નથી.

Aim and principle

Determine tap-pressure difference by tracing hydrostatic columns; include connecting-fluid density and elevation correction.

Apparatus and connections

Approved manometer/liquids, known tap elevations, pressure lines, scale and permitted flow rig.

Supervised procedure

Inspect compatible lines, zero and menisci before pressurising. Remove trapped bubbles by SOP.Record both interface levels and tap elevations at permitted steady conditions. Repeat and convert the signed vertical difference, not inclined length, to pressure.

body.en:
Task, report and evidence

Compare simple U, differential U and inclined-well instruments; label vertical head, densities, pressure basis and sensitivity. Work in a group and prepare about 5pages: objective/principle, labelled chart/model or method, comparison/calculations, findings/safety and conclusion/references. Record only genuine permitted photos, readings and presentation evidence.
body.gu:
Task, Report તથા Evidence

Simple U, differential U તથા inclined-well compare કરો.Vertical head, densities, pressure basis તથા sensitivity label કરો. Group માં આશરે 5pages નો report બનાવો: objective/principle, labelled chart/model અથવા method, comparison/calculations, findings/safety તથા conclusion/references.ફક્ત genuine permitted photos, readings તથા presentation evidence જોડો.

title.gu: Hydrostatic fluid element:z upward,h downward—labelled અભ્યાસચિત્ર
Inclined well manometer:use vertical head—labelled અભ્યાસચિત્ર
Continuous gravity decanter:two immiscible phases—labelled અભ્યાસચિત્ર

q.en: State the definition/principle of Ideal/real fluids;statics and dynamics.
q.gu: Ideal/Real Fluids;Statics અને Dynamics ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A fluid continuously deforms under an applied shear stress. A liquid is approximately volume-preserving under ordinary pressure changes; gas volume depends strongly on pressure/temperature. An ideal fluid is an inviscid model, not a substance with zero density. A real fluid has viscosity and dissipates mechanical energy. Fluid statics studies fluids at rest; fluid dynamics studies motion and its forces. A stationary ordinary fluid supports normal pressure but no sustained shear stress. Density is mass per volume; specific weight is weight per volume. Viscosity and compressibility are independent classifications: a liquid can be viscous yet nearly incompressible. State the modelling assumptions before using an ideal-fluid equation.
a.gu: Applied shear stress હેઠળ સતત deform થતો પદાર્થ Fluid છે.સામાન્ય pressure changes માં liquid નું volume આશરે સ્થિર રહે છે; gas નું volume pressure/temperature થી ઘણું બદલાય છે.Ideal Fluid inviscid model છે, zero-density substance નહીં.Real Fluid માં viscosity તથા mechanical-energy dissipation હોય છે.Statics માં rest પરના અને Dynamics માં motion તથા forces હેઠળના fluids નો અભ્યાસ થાય છે. Rest પરનો સામાન્ય fluid normal pressure સહન કરે છે, પણ sustained shear stress નહીં.Density એકમ volume દીઠ mass અને specific weight એકમ volume દીઠ weight છે.Viscosity તથા compressibility જુદા classifications છે; liquid viscous હોવા છતાં nearly incompressible હોઈ શકે છે.Ideal-fluid equation પહેલાં assumptions સ્પષ્ટ કરો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Pressure—static,dynamic,gauge,absolute and vacuum.
q.gu: Pressure—Static,Dynamic,Gauge,Absolute અને Vacuum ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Pressure is normal force per unit area. Static pressure is the local thermodynamic pressure measured by a correctly oriented wall tap. Dynamic pressure is the kinetic-energy-per-volume term, not an extra isotropic pressure acting at every wall. Vacuum indicates pressure below the local atmospheric pressure. Gauge pressure uses local atmosphere as zero; absolute pressure uses perfect vacuum as zero. Positive vacuum magnitude is atmospheric minus absolute pressure. Use absolute pressure for vapour-pressure/cavitation or gas calculations. Stagnation pressure equals static plus dynamic pressure only under the appropriate incompressible, negligible-loss stopping model. Pressure units are Pa=N m⁻².
a.gu: એકમ area દીઠ normal force એટલે Pressure.યોગ્ય wall tap થી મળતું local thermodynamic pressure એ Static Pressure છે.Dynamic Pressure kinetic energy per volume નો term છે; તે દરેક wall પર લાગતું વધારાનું isotropic pressure નથી.Local atmospheric pressure કરતાં ઓછું pressure એટલે Vacuum. Gauge Pressure નું zero local atmosphere અને Absolute Pressure નું zero perfect vacuum છે.Positive vacuum magnitude એટલે atmospheric minus absolute pressure. Vapour-pressure/cavitation તથા gas calculations માં absolute pressure લો.યોગ્ય incompressible, negligible-loss stopping model હેઠળ જ stagnation pressure static તથા dynamic pressure ના sum જેટલું થાય છે.Pressure નો SI એકમ Pa=N m⁻² છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Compressible and incompressible fluid models.
q.gu: Compressible અને Incompressible Fluid Models ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A compressible-flow model allows appreciable density changes. An incompressible model treats density as constant for the process under study. These are modelling descriptions, not simply synonyms for gas and liquid. Liquids are often approximated as incompressible; gases can also be approximately incompressible when pressure/density changes are sufficiently small. Compressibility matters in compressors, high-speed gases and pressure transients. Do not apply constant-density Bernoulli or a liquid flowmeter formula uncritically to a strongly compressible gas.
a.gu: Density માં નોંધપાત્ર ફેરફાર લેતું model Compressible છે.Process દરમિયાન density constant માનતું model Incompressible છે.આ modelling descriptions છે; ફક્ત gas તથા liquid ના synonyms નથી. Liquids ને ઘણીવાર incompressible માનવામાં આવે છે; ઓછા pressure/density changes ધરાવતો gas પણ આશરે incompressible માન્ય થઈ શકે છે.Compressors, high-speed gases તથા pressure transients માં compressibility મહત્વની છે.Strongly compressible gas માટે constant-density Bernoulli અથવા liquid meter formula બિનશરતી ન વાપરો.

q.en: State necessary assumptions for Hydrostatic-pressure equation—derivation.
q.gu: Hydrostatic-pressure Equation—Derivation માટે જરૂરી assumptions જણાવો.

a.en: Stationary constant-density fluid; z increases upward; g is constant. Consider a vertical element of area A and height dz.
a.gu: Stationary constant-density fluid; z ઉપર તરફ positive અને g constant છે.Area A તથા height dz વાળો vertical element લો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Simple U-tube manometer.
q.gu: Simple U-tube Manometer ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A simple U-tube manometer compares pressure through hydrostatic liquid columns. A transparent U-shaped tube contains a suitable manometric liquid. One limb connects to the pressure tap and the other is open to atmosphere for a simple gauge instrument. A graduated scale shows interface/free-surface elevations. The manometric fluid must be compatible, immiscible where required, and suitable for the pressure range; mercury is not a default classroom reagent. Applied pressure displaces the columns until hydrostatic equilibrium is established. Trace pressure downward by adding density×g×height and upward by subtracting it. For a gas over a much denser liquid, the gas-column correction is often negligible; for liquid-filled connections it may not be. The difference of vertical levels, not distance along the tube, is required. A positive tap pressure and a vacuum give opposite displacement directions.
a.gu: Hydrostatic liquid columns વડે pressure compare કરતું instrument Simple U-tube Manometer છે. Transparent U-shaped tube માં યોગ્ય manometric liquid હોય છે.Simple gauge instrument માં એક limb pressure tap સાથે અને બીજું atmosphere સાથે જોડાય છે.Graduated scale પરથી interface/free-surface elevations વાંચાય છે.Liquid compatible, જરૂર મુજબ immiscible અને pressure range માટે યોગ્ય હોવું જોઈએ.Mercury ને default classroom reagent ન માનવું. Applied pressure થી columns ખસે છે અને hydrostatic equilibrium બને છે.Pressure trace કરતાં નીચે જતાં density×g×height ઉમેરો અને ઉપર જતાં ઘટાડો.Dense manometric liquid ઉપર gas હોય તો gas-column correction ઘણીવાર negligible હોય છે; liquid-filled connection માં નહીં.Vertical level difference લેવો, tube ની length નહીં.Positive pressure તથા vacuum માં displacement ની directions વિરુદ્ધ હોય છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Inclined well-type manometer.
q.gu: Inclined Well-type Manometer ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: An inclined manometer improves sensitivity to small pressure differences. A large-area well is connected to a narrow transparent tube fixed at angle θ to the horizontal. A scale measures the displacement along the inclined limb. The well carries one pressure and the tube end the other, commonly atmosphere. The sketch assumes the well is sufficiently large for its level change to be negligible. A small pressure difference produces a relatively long scale movement because only its vertical component supplies hydrostatic head. This increases reading sensitivity for low gas-pressure differences. Use the actual angle and meniscus reference. If well depression is not negligible, include it in total vertical head rather than blindly using the sine relation alone. It is less compact and needs careful levelling.
a.gu: નાના pressure differences માટે વધુ sensitivity આપતું instrument Inclined Manometer છે. મોટા area વાળો well horizontal સાથે θ angle પરની narrow transparent tube સાથે જોડાય છે.Scale inclined limb ની displacement માપે છે.Well પર એક pressure તથા tube end પર બીજું, ઘણીવાર atmosphere, હોય છે.Sketch માં well area મોટું હોવાથી તેનો level change negligible માનેલો છે. ઓછા pressure difference થી લાંબું scale movement મળે છે, કારણ કે તેનો vertical component જ hydrostatic head આપે છે.તેથી નાના gas-pressure differences માટે sensitivity વધે છે.Actual angle તથા meniscus reference લો.Well depression negligible ન હોય તો total vertical head માં તેને ઉમેરો; ફક્ત sine relation ન લો.Instrument ને careful levelling તથા વધુ જગ્યા જોઈએ.

q.en: State necessary assumptions for Simple U-tube pressure equation—derivation.
q.gu: Simple U-tube Pressure Equation—Derivation માટે જરૂરી assumptions જણાવો.

a.en: Left limb connected to liquid at tap A, right limb open to atmosphere. Manometric density ρm, connected-fluid density ρ; a=zA−zL; h=zR−zL.Sketch shows positive gauge pressure.
a.gu: Left limb liquid tap A સાથે અને right limb atmosphere સાથે છે.Manometric density ρm, connected-fluid density ρ; a=zA−zL; h=zR−zL.Sketch positive gauge pressure માટે છે.

q.en: State necessary assumptions for Differential U-tube pressure equation—derivation.
q.gu: Differential U-tube Pressure Equation—Derivation માટે જરૂરી assumptions જણાવો.

a.en: Both tap lines contain the same fluid density ρ; heavy manometric liquid density ρm>ρ.Interface heights satisfy h=zR−zL.Tap elevations need not be equal.
a.gu: બંને tap lines માં સમાન density ρ તથા heavy manometric liquid density ρm>ρ છે.Interfaces માટે h=zR−zL લો.Tap elevations સમાન હોવી જરૂરી નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Differential-pressure cell.

a.en: A DP cell senses the difference between two applied pressures. It contains high- and low-pressure chambers separated by a sensing diaphragm or equivalent elastic element. Impulse lines transmit process pressures to these chambers. A mechanical linkage or electrical transducer senses deflection; an electronic transmitter may use capacitance, piezoresistance or another calibrated principle. The pressure difference produces a net force and diaphragm movement, which is converted to an indication/signal. It measures differential pressure directly; flow, level or filter resistance is inferred only with the appropriate model. Density, impulse-leg elevation, wet/dry legs and zero/span calibration affect the result. Isolate/equalise using the approved manifold sequence; do not expose a low-range cell to unbalanced process pressure.
a.gu: બે applied pressures નો તફાવત sense કરતું instrument DP Cell છે. તેમાં high તથા low pressure chambers વચ્ચે sensing diaphragm અથવા equivalent elastic element હોય છે.Impulse lines process pressures પહોંચાડે છે.Mechanical linkage અથવા electrical transducer deflection sense કરે છે.Electronic transmitter માં capacitance, piezoresistance અથવા અન્ય calibrated principle હોઈ શકે છે. Pressure difference થી net force તથા diaphragm movement થાય છે અને indication/signal મળે છે.Instrument સીધું differential pressure માપે છે; flow, level અથવા filter resistance માટે યોગ્ય model જરૂરી છે.Density, impulse-leg elevations, wet/dry legs તથા zero/span calibration result ને અસર કરે છે.Approved manifold sequence મુજબ isolate/equalise કરો.Low-range cell પર unbalanced process pressure ન આપો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Continuous gravity decanter.
q.gu: Continuous Gravity Decanter ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A continuous gravity decanter separates compatible immiscible liquids by density difference. A settling vessel provides a quiet separation zone for two substantially immiscible liquids of different density. It has a feed inlet/baffle, light-liquid overflow, heavy-liquid withdrawal and an arrangement to control the interface/outlet heads. A vent, inspection provisions and suitable level control complete the system; the diagram shows separate upper/lower liquid layers. The feed slows inside the vessel. Droplets of the heavier phase settle and lighter droplets rise/coalesce. The light phase leaves from the upper outlet and the heavy phase through its controlled lower route, allowing continuous separation. Interface position depends on densities, outlet elevations and backpressure, not density alone. Adequate residence time is essential; stable emulsions or mutually soluble components are not separated simply by increasing vessel height.
a.gu: Density difference વડે immiscible liquids નું continuous separation કરતું vessel Gravity Decanter છે. અલગ density ધરાવતા substantially immiscible liquids માટે vessel માં quiet settling zone હોય છે.Feed inlet/baffle, light-liquid overflow, heavy-liquid outlet તથા interface/outlet heads control કરવાની arrangement હોય છે.Vent, inspection તથા suitable level control જરૂરી છે.Diagram માં upper તથા lower liquid layers અલગ દર્શાવ્યાં છે. Vessel માં feed ધીમો પડે છે.Heavy droplets settle થાય છે અને light droplets ઉપર જઈ coalesce થાય છે.Light phase upper outlet તથા heavy phase controlled lower route થી સતત નીકળે છે.Interface position densities ઉપરાંત outlet elevations તથા backpressure પર આધારિત છે.Adequate residence time જરૂરી છે.Stable emulsions અથવા mutually soluble components ને ફક્ત vessel ઊંચું કરવાથી અલગ કરી શકાતાં નથી.
